figures.title: Three valid pairs need not share one world
figures.condition: Each Xi is a fair bit. An opposite pair has law 01,10 with probability 1/2 each; an equal pair has law 00,11 with probability 1/2 each. If all three pairs were opposite almost surely, X1≠X2 and X2≠X3 would force X1=X3, a contradiction. This is not inferred merely from one displayed assignment. With the third pair equal, the joint law P(010)=P(101)=1/2 realizes all three pair laws. Buttons flip all bits, retaining the same fair one-dimensional marginals. The picture shows a necessary consistency condition, not the extension theorem.

figures.title: Can the same present justify the decision?
figures.condition: Simple symmetric walk starts at 0 with its natural filtration. T=inf{n≥1:Sn=0}; L=max{0≤n≤4:Sn=0}. The shared prefix (0,1,0) is one F2 atom. figures.title: 跳链相同，寿命仍可不同
figures.condition: 精确模型：从状态1出发的纯生链j→j+1。令Eⱼ独立且为Exp(1)，等待τⱼ=Eⱼ/λⱼ，寿命ζ=Στⱼ。左λⱼ=1，由独立同分布强大数律ζ=∞几乎必然；不是仅凭Eζ=∞推断。右λⱼ=2ʲ，由Tonelli得Eζ=Σ2⁻ʲ=1，非负性遂给ζ<∞几乎必然。所有单段等待都严格正且速率有限。右图白色尾段均值恰为2⁻ⁿ；不声称ζ≤1，也不声称图中均值长度是实际等待。左右平均时钟示意不是共同数轴，不能比较其像素单位。爆炸后规则仍须另定，图不构造重启。

figures.title: Same jump chain, different lifetimes
figures.condition: Exact model: a pure-birth chain j→j+1 started at 1, with independent unit exponentials Ej, waits τj=Ej/λj and lifetime ζ=Στj. For λj=1, the iid strong law gives ζ=∞ almost surely; infinite expectation alone would not prove this. For λj=2^j, Tonelli gives Eζ=Σ2^(-j)=1, hence ζ<∞ almost surely by nonnegativity. Each wait is strictly positive and each rate finite. The unfilled tail has mean 2^(-n); this asserts neither ζ≤1 nor that displayed mean lengths are sample waits. The two diagrams use different display units, not a shared calendar axis. No post-explosion restart is constructed.

figures.title: 同一个核，两个方向的平均
figures.condition: 准确模型保持：P各行和为1，对角3/4、非对角1/4，μ=(p,1−p)，p∈{0,1/2,1}，f=(0,4)或(4,0)。μP=(1/4+p/2,3/4−p/2)。前者Tf=(1,3)、共同平均3−2p；后者Tf=(3,1)、共同平均1+2p。实色圆面积为概率，浅轮廓是单位参照；方框数为收益。P的四个条目通过出发行与到达列逐一标明，无重复交叉转移箭头。图只解释固定时刻的核与对偶平均，不以它代替半群、生成元定义域或Feller条件的证明。

figures.title: One kernel, two directions of averaging
figures.condition: Unchanged exact model: P is row-stochastic, with diagonal 3/4 and off-diagonal 1/4; μ=(p,1−p), p∈{0,1/2,1}, and f=(0,4) or (4,0). Then μP=(1/4+p/2,3/4−p/2). For the first payoff Tf=(1,3), with common mean 3−2p; for the second Tf=(3,1), with mean 1+2p. Filled disk areas are probabilities, pale outlines unit references, and boxed numbers payoffs. Each of the four P entries has its departure row and arrival column, without duplicated crossing transition arrows. This illustrates a fixed-time kernel and dual averaging, not a proof of semigroup generation, generator domains or Feller conditions.

figures.title: 先减有限均值，再接上无穷层
figures.condition: 模型沿用正文的二进时钟，k≥1，T=1。每层均值1、中心化方差2⁻ᵏ；图中分格是均值结构，不是模拟。Mᴺ=Σₖ≤ᴺJₖ−N是两个有限量之差；原正跳和发散的依据是正文Chebyshev与Borel–Cantelli，不是仅凭无限均值。平方尾vᴺ=Σₖ>ᴺ2⁻ᵏ=2⁻ᴺ。先对两个有限截断K>N比较D=Mᴷ−Mᴺ：终点二阶量=2⁻ᴺ−2⁻ᴷ≤vᴺ；整段E sup₀≤t≤1|D(t)|²≤4vᴺ是鞅最大界，不是等式或确定路径误差。极限构造后才用Fatou传递估计。上确界界经Markov推出ucp；一般构造的局部一致a.s.版本还须正文可求和概率及选列论证。蓝绿面积为已纳入方差，白色尾部保持真实面积，未人为放大。

figures.title: Center finite sums before taking a limit
figures.condition: The dyadic clocks are those in the text: k≥1 and T=1. Each layer has mean 1 and centered variance 2^(-k); subdivisions show means, not a simulation. M^N=Σk≤N Jk−N subtracts two finite quantities. Divergence of the raw positive-jump sum uses the text’s Chebyshev/Borel–Cantelli argument, not infinite expectation alone. The square tail is vN=Σk>N2^(-k)=2^(-N). For finite K>N, compare D=M^K−M^N: its terminal second moment is exactly 2^(-N)−2^(-K)≤vN. E sup0≤t≤1|D(t)|²≤4vN is a martingale maximal bound, not an equality or deterministic path bound. Fatou transfers the estimate only after constructing the limit. Markov yields ucp from this bound; the general locally uniform a.s. construction also needs the text’s summable-probability/subsequence argument. Filled area is included variance; the unfilled tail retains its true area, without enlargement.

figures.title: 换了权重，代价没有消失
figures.condition: 固定模型p=1/2、q=3/4，n显示64、512、4096。δₙ=1/(2n¹ᐟ³)，Aₙ={|K/n−q|≤δₙ}；同一n下P/Q使用同一事件。概率均由有限二项求和精确建立，显示值四舍五入；小于像素的质量不放大、不视为0。Pₙ/Qₙ对单条记录的密度比Lₙ=2ⁿ/3ᴷ，可随K变化，某些有限参数甚至可大于1；不能把整个事件回权成一个常数。以θ=log3、D=qlog3−log2，有exp[−n(D+θδₙ)]Qₙ(Aₙ)≤Pₙ(Aₙ)≤exp[−n(D−θδₙ)]Qₙ(Aₙ)。δₙ→0且Qₙ(Aₙ)→1才给速度n的极限D。选择单个频率格子不会使其Q概率趋1。本图没有把一般Cramér定理缩成可匹配倾斜的点。

figures.title: Changing weights does not erase the cost
figures.condition: Fixed p=1/2, q=3/4; displayed n are 64, 512, 4096. With δn=1/(2n^(1/3)), An={|K/n−q|≤δn}; P and Q use the same event at the same n. Finite binomial sums give exact probabilities, rounded for display. Subpixel positive masses are not enlarged or treated as zero. The record likelihood ratio Ln=2^n/3^K varies with K and can exceed one for some finite parameters; a whole event cannot be reweighted by one constant. For θ=log3 and D=qlog3−log2, exp[−n(D+θδn)]Qn(An)≤Pn(An)≤exp[−n(D−θδn)]Qn(An). Only δn→0 and Qn(An)→1 give limiting rate D at speed n. A single frequency cell does not have Q-probability tending to one. This does not restrict the general Cramér theorem to tilt-matched targets.
